elements.title: Paid-parking hot zones
elements.subtitle: Weekday-day parking gap where paid parking is within an 8-minute walk, central Columbus
elements.how_to_read: How to read this map: Shaded hexes have paid parking (meters, paid lots or garages) within an 8-minute walk: red needs more parking than is counted nearby, blue has spare supply. Outlined areas are hot zones short of parking by day and in the evening.
elements.sources: Sources: OSM parking & streets (Overpass, 2026-09); Overture buildings (2026-09-23.1); Franklin County Auditor parcels (2026-09-23); City of Columbus curb meters (2026-09); LODES WAC (2023); CTPP tract of work (2017-2021); CMS hospitals (2026-Q2); IPEDS (2024); OSM/Overture places (2026-09); Placer.ai office index (2026). © OpenStreetMap contributors.
